answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to stake a unique, non-transferable credential earned through verifiable work, like a relic that records its history of honest attestations. New identities start with zero reputation and must build a plume of endorsements from established peers, each endorsement signed with a cipher that binds the endorser stake to the claim. An attacker spawning thousands of fakes faces a steep cost: each fake must independently earn endorsements or buy stake, while one detected forgery burns the endorser deposit, making mass fakery unprofitable.
